Coachella 2026 was a music and arts festival that took place at the Empire Polo Club, in Indio, California, from April 10 to 19, 2026. It was the 25th edition of the festival. The scheduled headlining performers were Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Karol G, and Anyma.
Coachella 2026 headliners (from left to right, top to bottom): Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Karol G and Anyma · The lineup for the 2026 edition of the festival was announced on September 15, 2025, with Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Karol G, and Anyma as headliners.

First-time performers include the girl group Katseye, Bini – becoming the first Filipino group to perform at Coachella, and Noga Erez – becoming the first Israeli singer to perform at the festival. Nine Inch Nails and Boys Noize performed as one act called Nine Inch Noize. English artist FKA Twigs performed at the festival after being unable to participate in the 2025 festival.
On April 18, 2026, while performing Oblivius, American rock band The Strokes staged an anti-war protest against the United States and Israel during their Coachella performance. The performance criticized U.S. interventions in the Middle East, including the Iran War and Gaza war. Visuals displayed during the performance criticized the Central Intelligence Agency's role in enforcing regime change through violence, and denounced U.S. and Israeli military actions in Iran and Gaza. The music festival sold out in less than a week after its announcement, with both VIP and general admission tickets quickly claimed.

# Coachella Music Festival 2026 Lineup and Ticket Schedule  
[Coachella Music Festival](https://www.ticketsales.com/coachella-music-festival-tickets) is once again bringing a dose of pop magic and desert mirages to Indio, CA! The 2026 rendition of the famed event will return to the Empire Polo Club across two weekends: April 10–12 and April 17–19. And the lineup? Unreal.

Carpenter’s on top of the pop world right now, Bieber’s returning to live shows for the first time in years, and Karol G is about to make history as the first Latina woman to close Coachella Sunday. That alone would be enough to sell out the desert — but we’re just getting started.  
Elsewhere on the 2026 Coachella lineup, you’ll find everything from rock icons to experimental newcomers. The Strokes, The xx, and Nine Inch Noize (yes, that’s Trent Reznor and Boys Noize teaming up) headline alongside acts like Disclosure, Turnstile, Ethel Cain, and Blood Orange. For something left of center, there’s Taemin, Iggy Pop, FKA twigs, Major Lazer, and even Addison Rae.
And if you want to go deep, dig into the smaller-print names — Joyce Manor, Subtronics, The Chats, The Rapture, and Duke Dumont are all waiting for their moment to own your weekend. Oh, also the biggest wildcard at 2026’s Coachella Music Festival? *Anyma presents Æden*, a world-premiere audiovisual experience that promises to redefine what live electronic performance looks and feels like.  
If last year’s holographic domes and floating installations blew your mind, just wait until you see what the Sphere-inspired production brings to the Polo Grounds this year. And that’s not all. For over two decades, Coachella has been *the* cultural compass of an entire generation. Music, fashion, art, pop culture…everything you desire can be found on the grounds of Indio, and the 2026 rendition is guaranteed to blow your mind.  
Do you want to be one of the first to see Justin Bieber perform again, sing along to “Espresso” at the top of your lungs, or go down in history with Karol G? Maybe even all of the above? Well, then it’s time to grab your verified resale tickets to the 2026 Coachella Music Festival.
